resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Danish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: An independent whole-locale pass identified 25 actionable Danish translation defects in battery evidence, safety, and profile text; all 25 were corrected in this bounded iteration.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Danish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The removable-cell summary had redundant Danish phrasing.
evidence: Before: En aftagelig genopladelig celle, der bruges i kompatible enheder.
findings.resolution: Changed to a concise description of an aftagelig, genopladelig celle til kompatible enheder.

findings.summary: The integrated-battery summary used an awkward relative clause for user replacement.
evidence: Before: en celle, der kan udskiftes af brugeren.
findings.resolution: Changed to the clear compound brugerskiftbar celle.

findings.summary: The continuous-rating note omitted the ampere unit and retained an English-style article.
evidence: Before: 20 En kontinuerlig vurdering; pulsværdier bruges ikke.
findings.resolution: Changed to: 20 A kontinuerlig værdi; pulsværdier bruges ikke.

findings.summary: The comparison-value note used an English-style article after the numeric value.
evidence: Before: 20 En konservativ uafhængig sammenligningsværdi ...
findings.resolution: Rewrote the note as a Danish 20 A comparison value with correct agreement.

findings.summary: The exact-model note omitted A and used awkward test terminology.
evidence: Before: 15 En konservativ værdi fra eksakt modeltestning ...
findings.resolution: Changed to a 15 A value from test af den nøjagtige model.

findings.summary: The table-revision note used an awkward compound and omitted A.
evidence: Before: 45 En uafhængig kontinuerlig værdi for den testede tabells revision.
findings.resolution: Changed to a 45 A uafhængig, kontinuerlig værdi for tabelrevisionen.

findings.summary: The actual continuous value note used the false friend ægte and omitted A after 36.
evidence: Before: 36 En ægte kontinuerlig værdi ...
findings.resolution: Changed to: 36 A faktisk kontinuerlig værdi ...

findings.summary: The preproduction note omitted A and used unnatural verb wording.
evidence: Before: 40 En konservativ værdi; testede celler optrådte præ-produktion ...
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as a 40 A value and cells that så ud til at være præproduktion.

findings.summary: The recommended-rating note omitted A and translated cycle life too literally.
evidence: Before: 13 En anbefalet kontinuerlig værdi ... cykluslevetid.
findings.resolution: Changed to 13 A and the natural Danish lang levetid.

findings.summary: The temperature-limited note omitted A and used a hyphenated preproduction form.
evidence: Before: 40 En konservativ værdi ... præ-produktion.
findings.resolution: Changed to a 40 A value and standard Danish præproduktion.

findings.summary: The production-cell comparison note omitted A and used an awkward compound.
evidence: Before: 40 En produktionscelle sammenligningsværdi ...
findings.resolution: Changed to: 40 A sammenligningsværdi for produktionscellen ...

findings.summary: The exact-wrapper note used an inconsistent temperature unit and rewrap compound.
evidence: Before: 40 A nøjagtig indpakningsværdi ... 60 C ... rewrap.
findings.resolution: Changed to 60 °C and the natural EVE 40PL-rewrap wording.

findings.summary: The sample note omitted A and used awkward wording for exact testing.
evidence: Before: 19 En konservativ værdi; eksakt testede prøver så ud som præproduktion ...
findings.resolution: Rewrote the note as a 19 A value and nøjagtigt testede prøver.

findings.summary: The temperature-limited 90 A note omitted A after the conservative value.
evidence: Before: 40 En konservativ værdi; 90 A er temperaturbegrænset ...
findings.resolution: Changed to a 40 A conservative value with clear preproduction wording.

findings.summary: The production-continuity note omitted A and used an unnatural uncertainty phrase.
evidence: Before: 40 En konservativ værdi ... forbliver uafklaret.
findings.resolution: Changed to 40 A and produktionskontinuiteten er fortsat uafklaret.

findings.summary: The inconsistent-capacity note omitted A and used a less natural adjective.
evidence: Before: 40 En konservativ værdi; testede prøver havde inkonsekvent kapacitet ...
findings.resolution: Changed to 40 A and uensartet kapacitet.

findings.summary: The second preproduction note omitted A and used awkward exact-testing wording.
evidence: Before: 13 En konservativ værdi; eksakt testede prøver så ud som præproduktion ...
findings.resolution: Changed to 13 A and nøjagtigt testede prøver.

findings.summary: The tester-estimate note omitted A and used an ambiguous maximum phrase.
evidence: Before: 30 En testers estimeret kontinuerlig værdi ...
findings.resolution: Changed to 30 A estimeret kontinuerlig værdi fra testeren and a clear 50 A maximum.

findings.summary: The batch note omitted A and used a fragmented continuous-value phrase.
evidence: Before: 20 En kontinuerlig værdi fra to testede produktionsrelaterede batcher ...
findings.resolution: Changed to 20 A kontinuerlig værdi from the two tested batches.

findings.summary: The pulse-only note used an adjective where Danish requires an adverbial form.
evidence: Before: 12 A kontinuerlig; 20 A er kun puls.
findings.resolution: Changed to: 12 A kontinuerligt; 20 A er kun puls.

findings.summary: The exact-wrapper note used English source terms and omitted a natural warning about later revisions.
evidence: Before: wrapper revisioner ... sourcing ... kan afvige.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the note with Danish indpakning, rewrap-kilder, and revision wording.

findings.summary: The rewrap note used English wrapper and sourcing terms.
evidence: Before: wrapper-revisioner eller underliggende sourcing ...
findings.resolution: Changed to Danish indpakning and underliggende kilde wording.

findings.summary: The revision note used unnatural leg-count compounds and an English inheritance metaphor.
evidence: Before: fem ben; fire-bens ... må ikke arve denne profil.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as the nøjagtige fembensrevision and explicitly prohibited later revisions from inheriting the profile.

findings.summary: The low-drain safety warning was translated as low consumption rather than low discharge capability.
evidence: Before: Batteri med lavt forbrug; ikke egnet til vaping.
findings.resolution: Changed to: Batteri med lav afladningskapacitet; ikke egnet til vaping.

findings.summary: The regulated-device profile omitted the possible board interpretation present in the source context.
evidence: Before: En reguleret vaping-enhedsprofil for ...
findings.resolution: Changed to: Profil for en reguleret vaping-enhed eller et styrekort: ...
